_注: 旧0th EDITION 19種の効果文（英語）。cardId が鍵。tools/gen-0th-text.mjs が読む。
🔴 用語は src/card-text.en.js の頭にある対応表に合わせること（自分で言い方を発明しない）。
⚠ 隣・周囲はどちらも adjacent（リメイクの英語がそう訳してある）。
⚠ E・F・なないろの欠片はリメイクのものを使うので、ここには無い。

0th-red-dash.hand: If you made a normal move this turn, move 1 space.
0th-red-dash.flavor: You can look for your reason to run after you have started running.

0th-red-counterattack.arrival: If you have the fewest cards in hand, draw 2 cards and discard 1 card from your hand.
0th-red-counterattack.hand: Usable when contact is declared against you. Nullify that contact. You make contact with that opponent.
0th-red-counterattack.flavor: I knew you would come. (the one who waited)

0th-orange-force.arrival: Add 1 card adjacent to you to your hand.
0th-orange-force.hand: 【Color Cost 1】Choose 1 opponent. Move that opponent to any space with a card on it.
0th-orange-force.flavor: A current no one can resist is what people call fate.

0th-orange-lost-item.hand: Choose 1 opponent. Place this face-down on that opponent's Gate. Draw 1 card.
0th-orange-lost-item.flavor: This is yours, is it not? (a parcel belonging to no one)

0th-yellow-steal.arrival: Choose 1 player who has locked the most. Add 1 card at random from that player's hand to your hand.
0th-yellow-steal.flavor: To stand out is, in itself, to leave an opening.

0th-yellow-thunder.arrival: You are forced to move to your Gate; do not flip the card on the destination face-up.
0th-yellow-thunder.hand: Discard all cards on any 1 space.
0th-yellow-thunder.flavor: By the time the sound arrives, everything is already over.

0th-green-peoples-road.arrival: Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each of any 5 spaces with no card.
0th-green-peoples-road.hand: Choose 2 face-down cards on any 2 spaces that are not adjacent to an opponent. Place those 2 cards, still face-down, on any 2 spaces with no card.
0th-green-peoples-road.flavor: Join this, and everyone can walk it. (a nameless mason)

0th-green-rich-whim.arrival: Each player with 3 or more cards in hand places 1 card from their hand face-down on any space with no card. A card that could not be placed is discarded.
0th-green-rich-whim.flavor: Let those with the most to spare be the first to let go.

0th-blue-greedy-bridge.arrival:
Gain one of the following effects:
・Discard 1 card from your hand.
・You are forced to move to the space you were on before moving; do not flip the card on the destination face-up.
0th-blue-greedy-bridge.hand: Place this face-down on any space that is not adjacent to you. Choose 1 card from the cards adjacent to that space and place it directly beneath this.
0th-blue-greedy-bridge.flavor: A bridge joins both banks, but only for those ready to cross.

0th-blue-set-trap.hand: Place this face-down on any space that is not adjacent to you. Choose 1 card from the cards adjacent to that space and discard it.
0th-blue-set-trap.flavor: In time, even the one who set it forgets his own trap.

0th-pink-disclosure.arrival: Flip the cards on the center and the four corners of the field face-up. If there is no card to flip, flip the card on any 1 space face-up.
0th-pink-disclosure.hand: Draw 2 cards and reveal them. Their hand effects cannot be used this turn.
0th-pink-disclosure.flavor: To disclose and to expose are only a hair apart.

0th-pink-favorite-flower.arrival: Choose 1 opponent. Add this to that opponent's hand. If this was flipped face-up this turn, draw 1 card.
0th-pink-favorite-flower.hand: Choose 1 player who has locked the most. Place this face-up on a space with no player adjacent to that player. Draw 1 card.
0th-pink-favorite-flower.flavor: This is your favorite color, is it not?

0th-purple-wait.arrival: Add this to your hand. You are forced to move to the space you were on before moving; do not flip the card on the destination face-up. Move 1 space.
0th-purple-wait.hand: 【Color Cost 1】Usable when an opponent declares their final lock. Discard the card that opponent was going to lock. That opponent cannot lock this turn.
0th-purple-wait.flavor: It is not over yet. I will not let it end.

0th-purple-apocalypse.arrival: Place 1 card from your hand face-down on any space adjacent to you.
0th-purple-apocalypse.hand: Declare 2 colors. Draw 1 card and reveal it. If that card is a declared color, repeat from the beginning.
0th-purple-apocalypse.flavor: I can see the color that comes next. (the Prophet)

0th-white-colorful-hole.arrival: Add all cards on any 1 space to your hand.
0th-white-colorful-hole.hand: Choose 1 player who has locked the most. That player chooses 1 of their locked cards, and you add it to your hand.
0th-white-colorful-hole.flavor: A bottomless hole swallows every color there is.

0th-white-rainbow-rain.arrival: Place 1 card face-down from the deck on every space with no card.
0th-white-rainbow-rain.hand: Choose any 1 row or column of the field (7 spaces). Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each space in that line.
0th-white-rainbow-rain.flavor: The day the seven-colored rain fell, the world was leveled just once.

0th-black-faded-frog.arrival: Each player discards their entire hand. Choose 1 player who has locked the fewest. Add this to that player's hand.
0th-black-faded-frog.hand: Each player who has locked the most chooses 1 of their locked cards and discards it. Discard your entire hand.
0th-black-faded-frog.flavor: I can no longer remember what color it was.

0th-black-greedy-palette.hand:
Usable at any time. Declare 1 color. Each opponent gains one of the following effects:
・Choose 1 card of the declared color from their hand and add it to your hand.
・Discard 3 cards from their hand.
0th-black-greedy-palette.flavor: Every color is mine. (the Greedy Palette)

0th-black-rainbow-curse.basic: Locking onto the Lock Area where this is placed requires 2 or more cards of that color (only 1 card may be placed there per turn during the Lock Phase). If you lock there, place this face-down on any space.
0th-black-rainbow-curse.arrival: Place this face-up on an empty Lock Area of yours.
0th-black-rainbow-curse.hand: Choose 1 player who has locked the most. That player gains the Arrival Effect above.
